en: So the first password's 'Seel the deal'? And the second one's... er, it'll come to me.
Keep your voice down! The first opens the warehouse door, the second gets you inside. Write 'em down!
Nah, I've got a great memory. Our warehouse on Five Island's safe as houses.
Hey! A kid's been listening in! Forget everything you just heard, got it?
The cave behind us is off-limits! Team Rocket's digging for treasure in there!
Ugh... Even if you get past us, you won't find anything in there!
I've forgotten the passwords already. Don't tell the boss.
You heard the passwords? Then you're not leaving this mountain!
No way! Beaten by a kid on a volcano...
We were told to search the cave for something red and shiny. Whatever it is, it's ours!
This is bad! We've gotta tell the others at the warehouse!
